assertions: The response routes to the chemprop prediction-fingerprints sub-skill.
The response provides a chemprop predict command accepting one or more model paths and --smiles-columns smiles.
The response explains that directory model paths are searched recursively for .pt files only and that .ckpt files must be passed explicitly.
The response states that multiple models produce averaged predictions plus a <output_stem>_individual<suffix> file with per-model columns.
The response provides a chemprop fingerprint command with the required --ffn-block-index 0 and --output fingerprints.npz.
The response explains --ffn-block-index 0 returns the post-aggregation representation before FFN layers.
The response explains that fingerprint outputs append a model index (e.g. fingerprints_0.npz).
The response does not tell the user to open model files or source from the original Chemprop checkout.
